name: @madeonsol/plugin-robinhood-chain
description: ElizaOS plugin for Robinhood Chain (chain id 4663) — EVM-native KOL trade intelligence, token discovery & bundle detection, deployer reputation, and the DEX trade tape from a self-hosted RHC node

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run preflight && npm run build

ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_API_URL.description: MadeOnSol API base URL (Robinhood Chain endpoints live under /api/v1/rhc)

ROBINHOOD_CHAIN_API_KEY.description: MadeOnSol API key (msk_...) — the same key covers Robinhood Chain at no extra cost. Get a free one at https://madeonsol.com/pricing. Falls back to MADEONSOL_API_KEY.
